jurisdictions.name: Brazil

online_ggr.source: SPA / Ministry of Finance via iGaming Business

jurisdictions.tax_note: Pre-ban: 12% of GGR (2025) rising to 15% by 2028. Moot while the MP stands.
jurisdictions.note: BANNED BY DECREE. Medida Provisória 1.394 (25 Sep 2026) prohibits fixed-odds sports betting and online casino nationwide, including offshore sites: deposits stopped on publication, platforms offline from 6 Oct 2026, licences lapse after 30 days. Congress must confirm the MP within 60+60 days or it lapses; operators are challenging it in court and seeking back the >R$2.5bn of licence fees. State/federal lotteries are unaffected. Before the ban it was a R$37bn (≈$7bn) regulated market (Law 14.790, live Jan 2025; 87 licensees, Betano the largest brand) — the GGR figure below is that pre-ban history, now at zero. Listed names with Brazilian revenue include: Better Collective (≈15% of revenue), Flutter (Betnacional), Super Group, Evolution and Sportradar/Genius (supply); private: Kaizen (Betano), Superbet.

new.event: A unanimous Sixth Circuit panel ruled that Ohio and Tennessee may apply their state gambling laws to Kalshi's sports event contracts. This deepens the split with the Third Circuit.
new.rationale: State authority over sports prediction markets protects licensed operators from unlicensed, untaxed competition, and the circuit split raises the odds that the Supreme Court takes the question.
new.source_title: Appeals court rules that states can regulate Kalshi's sports prediction markets, dealing another legal blow to platforms

new.event: UKGC deposit-limit rules take effect after the Commission moved the date from 30 June 2026. Operators can only offer gross deposit limits over fixed time frames. A decision on Financial Risk Assessments is still pending.
new.rationale: Mandatory gross deposit limits add friction and compliance cost and could reduce player deposits and gaming revenue for online operators such as Flutter, Entain, Evoke and Betcob.

new.event: Deadline for lawmakers to file amendments to MP 1.394 closed with 47 proposals, some seeking a narrower ban.
new.rationale: Amendments seeking a softer ban show some support in Congress for a partial reopening, but the text that finally passes is still open.
new.source_title: Brazil Betting Ban Draws 47 Amendments Ahead Of October 13 Deadline

new.event: Authorisations of licensed fixed-odds betting operators are scheduled to be extinguished under MP 1.394, the same day as the presidential runoff.
new.rationale: Once the licences lapse, the operators have no legal basis to return even if the ban is later suspended, unless the Supreme Court (STF) or Congress restores the 2023 regime.
new.source_title: Brazil betting ban: Election polls tied as licences expire

new.event: TRF-3 president suspends the injunction that had exempted three CDA Gaming betting brands from MP 1.394, so the ban applies to them again until final judgment.
new.rationale: A first lower-court route to keep operating despite the ban has been closed, and the AGU and PGR are pushing the same line (suspending the lawsuits and leaving the question to the STF), which weakens the prospects of other operators' court challenges.
new.source_title: TRF-3 derruba liminar que liberou três plataformas de apostas

new.event: MP 1.394/2026 is expected to enter urgency regime and lock the agenda of the house where it is being processed, even though the joint committee is still not installed.
new.rationale: Urgency raises pressure for a floor vote on the fixed-odds ban before the 23 Nov deadline, so the ban could be confirmed or lapse, which decides whether BETS-B, BETCO, RSI, CDRO and PTEC can return to Brazil.
new.source_title: MP que proíbe bets se aproxima do regime de urgência sem comissão instalada

new.event: DGOJ resolution replaces the responsible-gambling message in gambling ads with a gambling-harm message from 5 December 2026 (resolution of 18 Sept 2026, published in the BOE on 6 Oct 2026).
new.rationale: Harder-hitting mandatory advertising warnings may reduce the effectiveness of marketing and acquisition by licensed operators.

new.event: Statutory deadline for the summary evaluation report on the Interstate Treaty on Gambling (§ 32 GlüStV 2021); it may prompt later changes to online slot, poker and betting rules
new.rationale: The evaluation of the German licensed regime, including player protection, advertising and the black market, shapes any later easing or tightening for licensed operators.

new.event: Royal Decree 520/2026 raises the minimum financial guarantee for general licences to €2.6m per licence (€650k for the type e) modality) in the initial period. After that it is €1.3m across all general licences held (€325k for type e only). Operators below these amounts must top up their guarantees.
new.rationale: Higher guarantees tie up more capital and cost more for every licensed operator, and for multi-licence groups most of all.
new.source_title: BOE-A-2026-13762 Real Decreto 520/2026, de 24 de junio, por el que se modifican el Real Decreto 1614/2011 ... para la introducción de un sistema de límites de depósito conjuntos por jugador y el Real Decreto 176/2023

new.event: Proposed date for the Gambling Act to switch to a participation test, covering any online game that can be joined from Sweden. It would also add liability for payment intermediaries that knowingly help unlicensed operators. This is a government memorandum (Ds 2025:23); no bill had been tabled as of the latest source I found.
new.rationale: Stronger action against unlicensed operators would help licensed operators such as Svenska Spel and Betsson, but the date is only proposed and may slip.

new.event: North Carolina's 6% tax on CFTC-registered prediction market operators' net trading fee revenue in the state starts, alongside the sportsbook rate rise from 18% to 23%.
new.rationale: A levy on prediction markets narrows their cost advantage over licensed sportsbooks such as DraftKings and FanDuel, but the same budget raises licensed operators' own tax rate.
new.source_title: north carolina sports betting tax state budget prediction markets

new.event: Final deadline for Congress to vote MP 1.394 once the recess is excluded from the count; if the committee is never installed or no vote is held, the MP lapses.
new.rationale: The ban stays in force until the MP is voted or lapses, and the legislature ends on 31 January 2027, so the outcome depends on the next Congress.
new.source_title: Proibição das bets: entenda o que está em jogo no STF e os próximos passos apostas no Brasil

new.event: Royal Decree 520/2026 joint cross-operator deposit limits (€700 daily, €1,750 weekly, €3,300 per four weeks) start to apply; operators must connect to the DGOJ system.
new.rationale: Player-level deposit caps across all licensed operators are likely to reduce deposit volumes and GGR, and operators face compliance and integration costs.
new.source_title: Nuevo Real Decreto sobre límites de depósito conjuntos en juego online

themes.label: Prediction markets vs state regulators (US)
themes.summary: CFTC-registered exchanges (Kalshi, Polymarket US, Crypto.com, Robinhood — and now FanDuel Predicts and DraftKings Predictions / DKeX) sell sports event contracts in every US state, including ones without legal betting and at no state gambling tax. The 3rd Circuit sided with Kalshi (Apr 2026), the 9th Circuit with Nevada (Aug 2026); New Jersey asked the Supreme Court to decide on 2 Sep 2026. Kalshi traded ~$16.8bn in May 2026, ~90% sports. A ruling for pre-emption would allow nationwide low-tax sports trading — a threat to state-licensed books' moat and state tax bases, partly hedged because DKNG and FLUT run their own exchanges. A ruling for the states confines prediction markets to non-sports contracts.
themes.status: At the Supreme Court — cert petitions filed Sep 2026

themes.label: Tax escalation
themes.summary: Online GGR taxes are going up across mature markets: UK remote gaming 21% → 40% (Apr 2026) and betting 15% → 25% (Apr 2027), Netherlands 37.8%, Mexico 30% → 50%, Brazil 12% → 15% by 2028, Illinois per-bet tax, hikes in Maryland, Louisiana and New Jersey. Scale operators with pricing power and product breadth absorb it; sub-scale ones exit, and over-taxed markets leak to offshore (see Netherlands).

themes.label: Channelisation — the black-market squeeze
themes.summary: Licensed share of play: Netherlands 49% by GGR, German slots 20-40% (industry estimate), Sweden casino 81%, Poland casino 62%, Brazil ~56-62% and improving. Channelisation is the swing factor between a regulation that grows a licensed operator's market and one that hands it to offshore — and the offshore side is where B2B suppliers' "unregulated" revenue comes from.
themes.status: Falling where tax and product limits bite
